title: Corporate Strategy
lead: The long-term plan that defines an organisation's direction, competitive positioning and value creation priorities.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Corporate strategy sets the overall ambition and direction of an organisation — what markets it operates in, what capabilities it needs, and how it creates sustainable value. It is the starting point for all downstream planning, including IT and digital strategy.

sections.heading: ITOM Perspective
sections.body: A sound IT Operating Model must be anchored to corporate strategy. ITOM engagements typically start by understanding the corporate strategy to ensure the target operating model supports the right business priorities — whether growth, efficiency, compliance or innovation.

items.desc: The long-term aspirational direction and core purpose of the organisation.
Time-bound objectives that translate vision into measurable outcomes.
How the organisation creates, delivers and captures value.
The choices made about where and how to compete.
Prioritisation of initiatives and investments to support strategic goals.
